source: scripts/word-headers-probe.sh: Microsoft Word saved headers_docx() (w:evenAndOddHeaders on) and the same document without w:evenAndOddHeaders as PDF; pdftotext -bbox, per page the words Word draws in the header band (y < 54 pt, the top margin), the body and the footer band (y > 138 pt). Every header/footer is its label plus a PAGE field, so 'p3' is the page NUMBER Word gives the page.
findings: A section without references shows the previous section's, per kind (S2 shows S1's; S3 its own default with S1's first and even).
titlePg is per section, not inherited (S2's first page shows the default header).
A kind no section has referenced is blank (S1's first and even footers), not the default.

With evenAndOddHeaders, Word inserted a BLANK page (no header, no footer) before S2, whose numbering restarts at 1 after page 3: two odd numbers in a row become odd, blank even, odd. Without evenAndOddHeaders there is no blank page.
